signal: PrimePay named a 2026 Frontrunner for Payroll by Software Advice and shortlisted by Capterra, running an HCM platform with 37 years of experience and 16,000+ clients

email.body1:
Tara, saw PrimePay land on the 2026 payroll Frontrunner and Capterra shortlists, with 16,000-plus clients on the HCM platform.

Recognition like that usually opens more SMB accounts than the team can touch, and good-fit prospects go cold before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PrimePay off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tara, quick follow-up for PrimePay.

Selling HCM into SMB is a volume game, and reps end up buried in research and CRM work instead of selling. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PrimePay needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tara, last bit of proof for PrimePay.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PrimePay's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tara, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and running a high-volume HCM sales motion keeps a manager busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SMB motion? I'll tailor it to PrimePay either way.
